translation.name: Nasoruan siGot len nasoruan ta Uluveu

content: Nǝmatan siJon Baptais
Nǝboŋ aHerot Antipas tosǝsǝloŋ hǝn na-kel-uri-an husur aYesu,
ikel mai naslev lotokǝtkǝta tǝban ke, “Atenan aJon Baptais bolai! Ile mǝhat dan nǝmatan, imagenan nǝdaŋan hǝn b̃igol namerikel gail ipat lan.”
AHerot ekǝmaienan husur a m̃o igol ke lototah gat aJon, riŋi len naim bǝbaŋis sil abareab siHerot, aHerotias tovi asoan aFilip, aHerot aṽan aFilip tosǝhar kuvi.
Lutah gat aJon husur ikel titau hǝn aHerot ke, “Len nalo sanor hǝn gǝb̃esǝhar alitenan.”
AHerot ike tigol aJon timat be emǝtahw len nǝlol paŋpaŋ sinaluṽoh bathut lunau ke aJon tovi ahai kelkel ur.
Len nǝhanan hǝn nǝboŋ nǝpasian siHerot, anatvavin aHerotias isav len nǝholito ale aHerot ehǝhaṽur habat hǝni.
Imagenan ita gat na-kel-gati-an sua hǝn b̃eviol hǝn natideh gai b̃elǝŋoni maii.
Ŋa nǝboŋ anan tokel maii hǝn nǝsa hǝn b̃eusi, natǝbarehreh ikel mai aHerot ke, “Nolǝŋon nǝkadun aJon Baptais, gegai, len nasiloh!”
Ale naut kǝmas ilolosa, bathut na-kel-gati-an san gai tota gati, mai alat lotosuh len nǝhanan, aHerot ikele hǝn nasoltia galevis ke tehum tousi.
Ale lovi lan naim bǝbaŋis, luta kotov nǝkadun aJon.
Loriŋ nǝkadun len nasiloh, pati, lavi mai natǝbarehreh topati vǝlavi mai anan.
Beti ahai susur siJon logǝmai, lupat niben van vǝtavuni. Ale nǝboŋ lototavuni tonoŋ, luvan hǝn aYesu, lukel nǝsa tovisi maii.
AYesu evǝŋan alalum̃an lotovi 5,000

Nǝboŋ aYesu tosǝsǝloŋ hǝn na-kel-uri-an husur aJon, isah len nab̃ot sua, eriŋ naut enan hǝn b̃itoh sǝb̃on len naut tob̃ǝb̃esw. Nǝboŋ naluṽoh gail lotosǝsǝloŋ hǝni, loriŋ nab̃iltivile gail, luyar a ut husuri.
Nǝboŋ aYesu tomariŋ dan nab̃ot, eris nab̃iltiluṽoh, nǝlon itaŋis galito ale igol alat lotomǝsah lumaur.

Nǝboŋ naut togomgom, ahai susur san gail logǝm hǝni, luke, “Naut eg ipat a tut dan navile gail. Namityal ivan p̃isi tia. Sǝvat naluṽoh van, hǝn lǝb̃evi lan navile gail hǝn lǝb̃idas hanian hǝn lǝb̃eṽuri.”
Ris aYesu tokel mai galit ke, “Salivan, gamit m̃au mitilav nǝhanian mai galito.”
Lukel maii ke, “Be namtsǝkad natideh gegai, natuhbǝta torim mai naieh toru ŋai.”
Ale ike, “Tariv gail gǝm, mai ginau.”
Beti ikel mai naluṽoh ke lebǝtah len naliol. Ale ilav nabǝta torim mai naieh toru, ekǝta vi lan nǝmav, ikel nasipaan. Eb̃ur gail, ilav nabǝta mai ahai susur san gail ale lopǝpehun gail mai naluṽoh.
Galit p̃isi luhan, luhanukub, ale losǝsǝŋon hudhuhanian van, gol nǝhad tovi 12 lopul.
Ikad alalum̃an lotovi 5,000 lotohan, be ikad alatpǝhaṽut mai alahutai am.
AYesu iyar len nǝp̃on nǝwai
Beti aYesu igol ahai susur gail lusah len nab̃ot hǝn lǝb̃eil a m̃o vi lan nǝtarhǝt nab̃iltiwai. Ale gai esǝvat naluṽoh gail hǝn lǝb̃eriŋ naut enan.
Nǝboŋ tosǝvat galit tonoŋ, aYesu etǝṽehuh sǝb̃on vi lan naṽehuh hǝn b̃isor mai aGot. Ale nǝboŋ naut togomgom itoh sǝb̃on ei.
Len namityal enan, nab̃ot isal vi rivuh a tut dan nǝtan. Nǝwai ekudkud vapus, gol iṽas nab̃ot husur isoh b̃ur nǝlan.
Len nadudulan som̃ilan naut sǝlan sal be aYesu egǝm hǝn galito, iyar len nǝp̃on nab̃iltiwai.
Nǝboŋ ahai susur gail lotoris toyaryar p̃oniwai, nǝkadulit eṽurṽur. Lukai ke, “Wao! Nanunun sua bolai.” Ale ninelit epil gol lukai habat.
Vǝha-sua ŋai aYesu isor mai galit ke, “Samtemǝtahw! Mǝteil b̃uri! Ginau bogai!”
APita ikai van hǝni ke, “Nasub̃, b̃evi gaiug kitin, kel mai ginau ke niyar len nǝp̃on nǝwai van hǝn gaiug.”
Ale ike, “Gǝmai!” Nǝboŋ aPita tomariŋ dan nab̃ot, iyar p̃oniwai van hǝn aYesu.
Be nǝboŋ aPita toris nǝlan todaŋ, emǝtahw, etub̃at sar maduŋduŋ ale ikai ke, “Nasub̃, numat! Liv kuv ginau!”
Vǝha-sua ŋai aYesu isar hǝn navǝlan, itah gati, ale ike, “Gaiug gotokad natuhdǝlomian ŋai, nǝlom̃ eur ginau mabe?”
Ale nǝboŋ artosah len nab̃ot, nǝlan idar buni.
Beti alat len nab̃ot lulotu hǝni ke, “Govi aNatun aGot kitin.”
Nǝboŋ lotolav tukot len nab̃iltiwai, luvahut len naut a Kennesaret.
Nǝboŋ alat len naut enan lotokǝta lǝboi aYesu, lopisul van hǝn naut p̃isi todar vis naut enan ale losǝhar alat lotomǝsah van hǝni.
Loŋiri ke tidam̃ hǝn lǝb̃ibar ŋai nasum̃arhǝt nahurabat san, ale galit p̃isi lotobari lumaur.
